what: SPAMPY 1.1: five-track synthwave FM-1 firmware with 170 synth presets, 44 drum kits including KAVINSKY, scenes, effects, 10 synthwave/atmospheric arpeggiators, extended envelope controls, corrected MIDI channel routing (no unintended synth or drum track triggering), dual-flash compatibility for original and newer FM-1 units, and 5 built-in arcade games.
